cases.purpose: Verify copy work limits immediately around the configured boundary.
cases.distinct_invariant: Atomic copy work accepts one below and exact capacity and rejects one above.
cases.expected_result: Boundary outcomes are structured and the original remains safe.

cases.purpose: Verify the post-publication directory-sync failure classification.
cases.distinct_invariant: A directory-sync fault after rename reports that a validated replacement was published.
cases.expected_result: The published state is reported without claiming the original remains active.

cases.purpose: Verify every injected failure before publication.
cases.distinct_invariant: Each prepublication fault preserves original bytes and removes the private copy.
cases.expected_result: No partial replacement is exposed at any injected stage.

cases.purpose: Verify mutation and validation callback failures.
cases.distinct_invariant: Mutation and replacement-validation errors leave the original unchanged.
cases.expected_result: The callback error is structured and original bytes are preserved.

cases.distinct_invariant: Missing and non-regular targets are rejected before private-copy mutation.
cases.expected_result: A structured target error is returned without publication.

cases.purpose: Verify the successful atomic publication path.
cases.distinct_invariant: A validated replacement is published with the original permissions preserved.
cases.expected_result: The replacement is visible only after successful validation and publication.

cases.purpose: Verify binary cursor input-size construction boundaries.
cases.distinct_invariant: Binary cursor construction accepts exact input capacity and rejects one byte above.
cases.expected_result: Exact capacity succeeds and excess input returns a structured limit error.

cases.purpose: Verify cumulative accounting across repeated reads.
cases.distinct_invariant: Rereads consume cumulative budget and rejection does not advance cursor state.
cases.expected_result: The exhausted read fails with position and budget preserved.

cases.purpose: Verify zero-length reading at the input end.
cases.distinct_invariant: An empty read at end-of-input succeeds without charging work.
cases.expected_result: The cursor remains at the end with zero additional work.

cases.distinct_invariant: An exact read advances position and cumulative work by precisely its byte count.
cases.expected_result: Returned bytes, cursor position, and work total match the request.

cases.purpose: Verify oversized range rejection before allocation.
cases.distinct_invariant: A huge truncated range returns a structured error without allocating its claimed size.
cases.expected_result: The range fails safely with bounded work and no panic.

cases.distinct_invariant: 32-bit and 64-bit floating reads preserve their exact IEEE bit patterns.
cases.expected_result: Decoded floating values reproduce the source bit representations.

cases.purpose: Verify signed and unsigned little-endian integer decoding.
cases.distinct_invariant: Every supported integer width decodes exactly in little-endian order.
cases.expected_result: Decoded integer values and cursor advancement match the input bytes.

cases.distinct_invariant: A read one byte above the per-read limit fails without advancing position.
cases.expected_result: A structured single-read limit error preserves cursor state.

cases.distinct_invariant: A truncated fixed-width primitive read propagates error without partial advancement.
cases.expected_result: The cursor position remains unchanged after structured truncation.

cases.distinct_invariant: Seeking to start or exact end succeeds while seeking past end is rejected.
cases.expected_result: Valid positions are retained and the invalid seek preserves prior state.

cases.distinct_invariant: Truncation reports the request offset, needed bytes, and available bytes exactly.
cases.expected_result: The returned error contains complete checked boundary context.

cases.distinct_invariant: Formatted structured errors retain the operation and boundary context needed for diagnosis.
cases.expected_result: The display text includes the structured error's relevant fields.

cases.distinct_invariant: Default input, single-read, and cumulative-read limits match the documented policy.
cases.expected_result: Every default equals its documented numeric constant.

cases.distinct_invariant: Zero, unit, and maximum explicit read-policy values are preserved exactly.
cases.expected_result: Policy accessors return each supplied boundary unchanged.

cases.distinct_invariant: Zero and exact-boundary charges update cumulative work without overcharging.
cases.expected_result: The work total equals the sum of accepted charges.

cases.distinct_invariant: Input length at the ceiling succeeds and one byte above is rejected.
cases.expected_result: The over-limit result identifies requested and maximum bytes.

cases.purpose: Verify cumulative read counter overflow handling.
cases.distinct_invariant: Cumulative read addition overflow returns arithmetic error without wrapping or mutation.
cases.expected_result: The counter retains its prior value after overflow rejection.

cases.purpose: Verify failed read charges are atomic.
cases.distinct_invariant: Single-read and cumulative-limit rejection never charges partial work.
cases.expected_result: Both failure paths preserve the pre-request work total.

cases.distinct_invariant: Byte-count addition and subtraction accept exact representable boundaries.
cases.expected_result: Checked count operations return the exact boundary values.

cases.distinct_invariant: Byte-count overflow and underflow return structured arithmetic errors.
cases.expected_result: No count operation wraps or panics.

cases.purpose: Verify native-size conversions for typed offsets and counts.
cases.distinct_invariant: Representable native-sized values round-trip through typed byte values exactly.
cases.expected_result: Conversion returns the original representable value.

cases.distinct_invariant: Byte-offset arithmetic accepts the last exact representable result.
cases.expected_result: Checked offset operations return exact boundary positions.

cases.distinct_invariant: Byte-offset overflow and underflow fail structurally without wrapping.
cases.expected_result: Invalid offset math returns a checked arithmetic error.

cases.distinct_invariant: Adding a local page offset to an absolute start cannot wrap.
cases.expected_result: Overflow returns a structured arithmetic error.

cases.purpose: Verify page references against empty geometry.
cases.distinct_invariant: An empty source geometry rejects page reference zero.
cases.expected_result: The first reference is identified as outside the zero-page database.

cases.purpose: Verify page-count derivation at exact file boundaries.
cases.distinct_invariant: Exact multiples of page size derive the corresponding complete page count.
cases.expected_result: Geometry reports the precise number of full pages and no partial page.

cases.distinct_invariant: The last byte is valid while exact page end and one byte above are invalid local offsets.
cases.expected_result: Boundary validation distinguishes addressable bytes from end positions.

cases.purpose: Verify partial-page geometry around exact capacity.
cases.distinct_invariant: File lengths one below and one above a full-page boundary are identified as partial.
cases.expected_result: Complete page count and trailing byte count are exact on both sides.

cases.purpose: Verify calculated byte ranges for boundary pages.
cases.distinct_invariant: First and last valid page ranges cover their exact non-overlapping source bytes.
cases.expected_result: Calculated start and end offsets match database geometry.

cases.distinct_invariant: Page-number to byte-offset multiplication cannot wrap.
cases.expected_result: An unrepresentable page start returns a structured arithmetic error.

cases.purpose: Verify page references immediately beyond valid count.
cases.distinct_invariant: References equal to page count and one above are both rejected.
cases.expected_result: Each invalid reference reports the available page count.

cases.purpose: Verify page geometry uses captured source length.
cases.distinct_invariant: Page geometry construction observes only the source length captured at source creation.
cases.expected_result: Later source changes cannot silently alter established geometry.

cases.purpose: Verify typed page number, size, and offset boundaries.
cases.distinct_invariant: Typed page values preserve zero and maximum representable valid boundaries.
cases.expected_result: Constructed page values return their exact source integers.

cases.distinct_invariant: Native conversion of unrepresentable page values fails rather than truncating.
cases.expected_result: Conversion returns a structured arithmetic error.

cases.distinct_invariant: Zero page size is invalid for both empty and populated sources.
cases.expected_result: Geometry construction rejects zero before division or allocation.

cases.distinct_invariant: Aggregate work rejection preserves every individual resource counter.
cases.expected_result: No dimension is partially charged by an aggregate failure.

cases.purpose: Verify allocation accounting boundaries and aggregation.
cases.distinct_invariant: Allocation accepts exact capacity while one-over and aggregate failures are atomic.
cases.expected_result: Rejected allocations leave both allocation and total-work counters unchanged.

cases.distinct_invariant: Exact chain depth succeeds and one-over fails without mutating accounting.
cases.expected_result: Depth validation returns a structured limit error at one above.

cases.distinct_invariant: Single-value and cumulative decoded-byte ceilings are enforced independently.
cases.expected_result: Each exceeded dimension reports its own structured limit kind.

cases.distinct_invariant: Every parser resource default matches the documented numeric policy.
cases.expected_result: All public default accessors equal their documented constants.

cases.purpose: Verify overflow handling for all cumulative resource counters.
cases.distinct_invariant: Every cumulative counter rejects u64 overflow without mutation.
cases.expected_result: No resource counter wraps or partially advances.

cases.distinct_invariant: Item work accepts exact capacity while local and aggregate excess fail atomically.
cases.expected_result: Rejected item charges preserve all relevant counters.

cases.distinct_invariant: Page visits accept exact capacity while local and aggregate excess fail atomically.
cases.expected_result: Rejected visits do not change page or total-work counters.

cases.purpose: Verify integration between operation and read budgets.
cases.distinct_invariant: The read budget persists as a sub-budget and contributes to operation work.
cases.expected_result: Read accounting remains visible through the enclosing operation budget.

cases.distinct_invariant: Total work accepts exact capacity while one-over and combined excess fail atomically.
cases.expected_result: Failed charges preserve the previous total and dimensional counters.

cases.distinct_invariant: The library identifies only Access 97 and Jet 3 as its target format.
cases.expected_result: The public format name exactly matches the declared narrow scope.

cases.purpose: Verify slice and file out-of-range parity.
cases.distinct_invariant: Slice-backed and file-backed sources reject identical invalid ranges equivalently.
cases.expected_result: Both source types return the same structured boundary class.

cases.purpose: Verify empty source geometry and reading.
cases.distinct_invariant: Empty sources retain zero geometry and accept only an empty read at the end.
cases.expected_result: Slice and file sources agree without charging work.

cases.distinct_invariant: File source construction accepts exact file capacity and rejects one byte above.
cases.expected_result: Oversize files return a structured input limit error.

cases.distinct_invariant: File length is captured once and later growth is not exposed through established geometry.
cases.expected_result: Reads beyond the captured length remain rejected.

cases.distinct_invariant: Offset-plus-length overflow is rejected before any underlying source access.
cases.expected_result: A structured arithmetic error is returned with zero I/O.

cases.distinct_invariant: Opening a missing source maps the platform failure to structured I/O context.
cases.expected_result: The error identifies the open operation and not-found kind.

cases.distinct_invariant: Single and total read-limit failures leave the source budget unchanged.
cases.expected_result: No rejected preflight request consumes read budget.

cases.distinct_invariant: Slice-backed and file-backed sources return identical bytes for identical valid ranges.
cases.expected_result: Returned bytes and work totals match across source implementations.

cases.distinct_invariant: Slice source construction accepts exact capacity and rejects one byte above.
cases.expected_result: Oversize slices return a structured input limit error.

cases.purpose: Verify shared operation accounting across readers.
cases.distinct_invariant: A source and binary cursor share and exhaust one enclosing operation budget.
cases.expected_result: Combined work cannot bypass the operation ceiling.

cases.purpose: Verify file truncation after length capture.
cases.distinct_invariant: A later-truncated file reports actual short-read bytes and charges attempted I/O.
cases.expected_result: The structured short-read error and budget reflect the failed access.

cases.distinct_invariant: Wrapping an open file is independent of its preexisting stream cursor position.
cases.expected_result: Absolute reads return the intended bytes regardless of prior cursor state.

cases.distinct_invariant: Fixture metadata derives its format name from the production library scope.
cases.expected_result: Testkit and library report exactly the same scoped format name.
